endpoint.selection: Published global endpoint or exact scoped override; no inferred region/pool
endpoint.scope: account IAM, exact child with explicit caller user parent; no implicit current-user fallback
endpoint.ref_validation: Caller ResourceRef scope/service/generation/kind/endpointID/URL and root shape checked before credential/resource I/O

request.auth: account IAM, exact child with explicit caller user parent; no implicit current-user fallback

response.mapping: Typed ProxyTokenInfo fingerprint/name/active/serials; create additionally returns single-delivery protected token. Exact fingerprint scanned before unrelated fields; caller user parent only on explicit user-admin path. Delete validates returned fingerprint against exact caller ref; foreign refs never adopted. Required false and empty serials retained.

errors.mapping: Shared status taxonomy with documented400/401/403/404/409/429 as applicable, safe provider diagnostics; mutation receipt retained even pre-I/O validation and post-acceptance decoding failures.

retry: No replay; one resource attempt on unknown outcome. Documented 4xx rejection statuses retain rejected receipt;500/transport/decode failures preserve uncertainty/acceptance as applicable.

recovery.reason: No direct token Get/status or causal proof; single-delivery secret cannot be recreated; no replay, name lookup or inferred adoption.
